Maya Rivera: Pushing a small design update for the latency panel. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/latency-panel-ux

Quick summary:
- Move p95 header into a compact left column; show a tiny throughput sparkline inline with label so the heatmap can occupy full width.
- Time range picker stays top-right; propose moving sampling control to the left of the presets as a compact dropdown labeled \"Sampling\" with options: Off / 10% / 25% / 100% + Custom.
- When sampling is >0, show a subtle \"Sampled\" badge next to the chart title with an info tooltip explaining approximation.
- Provide a keyboard path: Tab -> Time presets -> Sampling -> Calendar -> Apply. Need to validate focus order.

Please share quick feedback, specifically on: badge wording, sampling control affordance, and collapse behavior on small screens.

Ethan Brooks: Nice. A few thoughts:
- Badge wording: prefer just \"Sampled\" (no parens). Tooltip: one line: \"Results are approximate when sampling is enabled.\" link to docs.
- Sampling as dropdown is fine, but custom slider could be hidden behind a 'Custom...' option to avoid clutter.
- Sparkline: show p50 and p95 overlays on hover to give context. Keep it tiny though.
- Small screens: collapse the sparkline and move the badge into the kebab menu to save space.

Priya Nair: Accessibility notes:
- Ensure the sampling dropdown is a <button aria-haspopup=\"listbox\"> pattern and exposes the current option as plain text in DOM.
- The \"Sampled\" badge must have aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip text. Do not rely on hover-only tooltips.
- Color contrast: heatmap coldest color needs boost; the 10% bucket labels at 11px fail contrast.
- Keyboard: allow Left/Right on the dropdown when open to change selection, Escape to close.

Diego Santos: Product/metrics perspective:
- Show the effective sample rate next to the badge when sampling != Off, e.g., \"Sampled • 10%\" so users see exactness.
- We should record the sampling value in telemetry for each query; add to the query metadata field.
- UX: if sampling is applied across the whole dashboard (global toggle), indicate that at the top; otherwise make it clear it's time-scoped.

accessibility-bot: Auto checklist added to ticket INFR-4380:
- [ ] Sampling dropdown uses accessible button+listbox pattern
- [ ] Badge has aria-describedby and visible text fallback
- [ ] Sparkline collapses on narrow viewports
- [ ] Effective sample percent displayed in DOM near badge
- [ ] Keyboard navigation: Tab order validated; listbox Left/Right

Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-4380

Maya Rivera: Updated Figma with the tiny 'Sampled • 10%' mock and a Custom modal for the slider. Also added two microcopy options for the badge tooltip:
1) \"Sampled: view shows a subset of requests; numbers are approximate.\"
2) \"Sampled: only a portion of traffic is displayed; use 100% for exact results.\"

Which reads better for non-technical users?

Ethan Brooks: Prefer option 1 — shorter and softer.

Also, small nit: change the dropdown label to just \"Sampling\" not \"Sampling rate\" to keep it compact.
Priya Nair: Agree on option 1. For screen readers, the tooltip can be announced as: \"Sampled. Note: view shows a subset of requests; numbers are approximate.\"

Diego Santos: Ok with option 1 too. I'll loop in infra to ensure the sampling percent is captured in query logs.

One question: If users pick an aggressive sampling like 1%, should we surface a confidence hint? Maybe a small \"low confidence\" icon when sample <5% that explains noise.

Maya Rivera: Good call. I'll add a low-confidence state that turns the badge orange and shows a short note in the help panel. Planning a short playtest Wed 9am PT to validate keyboard flow and responsive collapse. Invite: @Priya Nair @Ethan Brooks @Diego Santos.

Ethan Brooks: I'll attend and bring a fast checklist for mobile widths.

Thanks!

Priya Nair: I'll run an a11y pass during the playtest and record issues.

Maya: please add the sample keyboard script to the ticket.
Maya Rivera: Done — added keyboard script & the playtest recording link to the ticket. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
